color.summary: Two themes from @carbon/themes: White for light and G100 for dark. White pages are #fff with layer-01 (#f4f4f4) for fields, menus, tiles and modals, #161616 ink, #525252 secondary and #6f6f6f helper text. G100 is #161616 with #262626 layers, #f4f4f4 ink and #c6c6c6 secondary. IBM blue #0f62fe is the primary button, the links and the focus outline; in G100 links turn #78a9ff and focus turns white. Fields draw a 1px #8d8d8d line under them (#6f6f6f in G100). Secondary buttons are #393939, errors #da1e28 (#fa4d56 in G100).
usage: Controls on a layer step up one token: inside a modal or on a tile, fields use field-02 (#fff in White, #393939 in G100).
Tags come in color types, each a 20-grade tint under 70-grade text (#d0e2ff under #0043ce for blue), swapped in G100.
Tooltips and notifications use background-inverse: #393939 in White, #f4f4f4 in G100.
AI-labelled parts add a blue gradient glow and a #4589ff edge or line.

type.summary: IBM Plex Sans for all UI and IBM Plex Mono for code, theme tokens and date fields. Most UI is body-compact-01: 14px on an 18px line with 0.16px tracking. Labels, helper text and Tags are 12px on 16px with 0.32px. Buttons and menu rows stay at 400; 600 marks table headers, the selected tab and notification titles. Productive headings are 400 too.

shape.summary: Square: buttons, fields, menus, modals, tiles and tables have no rounding. Tooltips, popovers and toggletips round 2px, the ContentSwitcher 4px and the AI label's popover 8px. Tags are pills, as are the count badge and the slider thumb.

spacing.summary: Carbon's spacing tokens step 2, 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 40 and 48px, and 16px is by far the most common: field and menu row sides, tile padding. One height ladder runs through buttons, fields, menus and tabs: 24, 32, 40 and 48px, with 64px for fluid fields and modal footer buttons.

elevation.summary: Flat and layered: depth comes from layer tokens (#f4f4f4 on #fff, #262626 on #161616), not shadows. Menus, dropdown lists and the date picker add 0 2px 6px at 30% (80% in G100), toasts the same at 20%. Modals have no shadow, only a 1px edge over a 60% black overlay. Focus is drawn inside the box: a 2px #0f62fe edge (white in G100), with a 1px white ring inside it on buttons.

button.summary: Seven kinds share one square shape: primary (#0f62fe), secondary (#393939), tertiary (a 1px #0f62fe outline that fills on hover), ghost (no fill, #0f62fe text), and danger, danger tertiary and danger ghost in #da1e28. Labels sit at the start at 14px/400, with 15px leading and 63px trailing padding for the icon slot. Sizes run xs 24px, sm 32px, md 40px, lg 48px (the default), xl 64px and 2xl 80px. Disabled filled buttons turn #c6c6c6 under #8d8d8d text.
usage: Modal footers use xl (64px) buttons that run full bleed, secondary beside primary or danger.
Icon-only buttons are squares at the button's height.

provenance.notes: Written block by block from the census (spec.json, census 154a8a6) and its page shots: 499 Carbon React Storybook stories, headless in White (light) and G100 (dark). Facts the census can't see (tooltip bubbles, the checkbox box, DataTable rows, modal and tile defaults) come from the Carbon pack's hand-read notes and are marked as such. Names without a from are Storybook args and component classes; names marked docs come from Carbon's component, story and prop names; names marked ai are ours.
